8adcoach.text: 8adCoach has been fighting since 2016 and still reads like a model card: top-tier in the matchups, quick in tempo, with bravery holding steady as the opposition hardens. The clash kill-death ledger sits well above average, while headshots land above the pack. The lifetime board mirrors the duels, which keeps the story tidy. A veteran who still sets the pace in every fight.

8yzanc.text: 8yzanc plays a solid, unspectacular game: clear of the middle in the matchups, fast enough to hold the tempo up, and composed as the enemies improve. The lifetime numbers sit mid-pack, a plainer read than the matchups give. A reliable regular who turns up and holds their own.

8925dh.text: Since 2016, 8925DH has played a fast, accurate game with an all-round mark well above average, a fast tempo, and a matchup record resting in the middle. Accuracy runs above the middle while headshots sit lower, and the lifetime figures run a notch hotter than the matchups. When the fight turns hardest, the touch dips — the single wrinkle in a long, steady career.
